Package com.radiantlogic.iddm.base

Interface AuthenticationOperations<IN extends AuthenticationRequest,OUT extends AuthenticationResponse>

Type Parameters:
IN - The request type accepted by this class
OUT - The response type returned by this class
All Superinterfaces:
Connector
public interface AuthenticationOperations<IN extends AuthenticationRequest,OUT extends AuthenticationResponse> extends Connector
Defines methods for connectors that can perform authentication operations against the backend data source.

To use, the developer needs only to create a class that implements this interface and each of its methods (as no default implementations are provided). For example: 


 class CustomConnector implements AuthenticationOperations<LdapBindRequest, LdapResponse<String>>
